payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.lead: Salaries, bonuses, deductions and sales commissions for the month. A month's salary counts as an expense once it is marked paid.
payroll.employees_lead: Your team, their pay and commission schemes.
payroll.delete_confirm: Delete {name}? Their payroll history is deleted too. Type the name to confirm.
payroll.monthly_net_help: Base + bonus − deductions. Commissions are added from the orders they sell.
payroll.register_sub: Net pay = salary + commissions earned on the month's orders
payroll.pay_one_confirm: Mark {name}'s salary of {amount} for {month} as paid? It will be counted as a payroll expense for that month.
payroll.pay_all_confirm: Mark {n} salaries for {month} as paid? They will be counted as payroll expense for that month.
payroll.unpay_confirm: Undo the payment for {name}? The salary will no longer be counted as an expense for this month.
payroll.rule_note: Salaries are recognised as an expense only in months marked paid (inactive employees are never counted). Commissions are always counted in the month of the order.
payroll.empty_text: Add your team with their base salary and commission scheme to run payroll.
payroll.region_rates_help: Optional. When an order's customer is in one of these regions, this rate replaces the default commission rate.
payroll.commission_explain: Percentage: the rate × the order total (after discount, including the delivery fee). Fixed: the rate is paid once per order.
payroll.no_history_text: Paid months appear here with a payslip.
payroll.no_sales: No orders assigned to this employee
payroll.no_slip: No payroll data for this month
